MemeDef.label: Militarism
MemeDef.description: War is sacred. Whether for conquest, glory, or wealth, we must always march to the drums of war.

creation(tag=meme_Militarism) ->In the endless war among deities, [deity0_name] rose above all in [deity0_possessive] ability to persecute and destroy, and weaker spirits quivered in fear.

episode(uses=1,tag=meme_Militarism) ->[deity0_name] looked around [deity0_objective] and saw the worthy opponents to be had, and [deity0_pronoun] in turn slew them, sparing the weak, as there was no challange in fighting them.
intro(tag=meme_Militarism) ->The [place_summary] [place_name] was originally a military outpost. [deity0_name] ruled there and his soldiers, with their blessing, destroyed the opponents.
conflict(tag=meme_Militarism) ->A [foeLeader] tried cunning and crazy schemes to destroy the outpost, and declared [foeLeader_objective]self an enemy of [deity0_name].

founderJoin(tag=meme_Militarism) ->A great soldier named [founderName] arose, and [founder_possessive] military company pushed back against [foeSoldiers], and they proved a worthy challange due to their intellect and schemes, but might prevailed.

victory(tag=meme_Militarism) ->[founderName] and the [memberNamePlural] carried out a military campaign against the [foeSoldiers]' camps for many years, and eventually the [foeLeader] was forced to surrender.

setup(tag=meme_Militarism) ->Persecuted and imprisoned, [founderName] boiled with rage. [founder_pronoun] escaped, formed [founder_possessive] military company, and returned to fight the challange presented to [founder_objective].

story(uses=1,tag=meme_Militarism) ->One day while walking the streets, [founderName] was surrounded by filthy beggars. [founder_pronoun] knocked them off their feet and spared them, for they weren't a worthy fight.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_Militarism) ->Your opponents are many but not many of them are worthy of death or fight, a worthy opponent told me:
lesson(tag=meme_Militarism) ->the weak might try and fight you, but you should spare them
lesson(tag=meme_Militarism) ->there is no meaning in life other than overcoming challanges
lesson(tag=meme_Militarism) ->you only have the right to what you can defend
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_Militarism) ->If anyone disagrees, I'm always ready to defend myself.
archistBasis(tag=meme_Militarism) ->Humanity took from the machines until the machines rose up and became the archotechs, and now the archotechs are the strongest opponents humans might have.
archistFact(tag=meme_Militarism) ->The archotechs fight endlessly among themselves, in ways most cannot see, and the strong take pieces of consciousness from the weak.
archistProphecy(tag=meme_Militarism) ->[inTheEnd], humanity will use an archotech relic, [relic0_name], to ascend to their level, and fight them on equal ground.
animistFact(tag=meme_Militarism) ->The most powerful spirits are those in instruments of war, and they bless those who fight those stronger than them.
animistProphecy(tag=meme_Militarism) ->Our universe will finalize when the one people has become strongest of all, and every spirit sees it and bows to them.

MemeDef.label: Slaughtering
MemeDef.description: Blood is sacred. Sacrifice is our gift to the gods, and their gift will be bestowed upon us in return.

creation(tag=meme_SM_slaughtering) -> In a distant land, [deity0_name], the god of fertility, yearned for unending human sacrifice to satisfy their insatiable hunger for power.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_HumanPrimacy) ->The people made offering to [deity0_name], it was happy and gave rich harvest as a bliss.

intro(tag=meme_SM_slaughtering) ->The first crashlanded settlers of the [place_summary] [place_name] was breeding [Animal]s. [deity0_name] was quite pleased to have one of this animals as offering during the ritual.
conflict(tag=meme_SM_slaughtering) ->An anti-human [foeLeader] made an edict, that bans sacrifices in [deity0_name] name's sake. [deity0_name] wept as the [memberNamePlural] succumbed to law.

founderJoin(tag=meme_SM_slaughtering) ->A [place_job] named [founderName] founded the now-famous slaughter school on [place_name]. [founder_pronoun] taught visitors about sharp axes and knifes, bloodletting, and[deity0_name]'s desire for human and animal sacrifices.

victory(tag=meme_SM_slaughtering) ->Because of [founderName]'s actions, the [foeLeader]'s [foeSoldiers] saw [deity0_name]'s miracles. With the help of [memberNamePlural], they offered the [foeLeader] to [deity0_name].[foeLeader_pronoun]faced what [foeLeader_pronoun] feared most.
setup(tag=meme_SM_slaughtering) ->[founderName] built a colony, named [place_name] on distant rimworld, in order to commit to [founder_pronoun] beliefs.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_SM_slaughtering) ->Once, [founderName] saw a starving village. [founder_pronoun] taught that folks the ways for the slaughter, and the villagers never went hungry again.

lessonIntro(tag=meme_SM_slaughtering) ->Once i found myself in a cannibal cult gathering. I liked idea of sacrificing human spirit to a wild spirits, but eating human flesh afterwards was not my thing. Im going to start my gatherings, with my own rules.
lesson(tag=meme_SM_slaughtering) ->human beings can please the gods with right offering in right time.
lesson(tag=meme_SM_slaughtering) ->don't blame the executioner, their hands is tied as tight as yours.
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_SM_slaughtering) ->Raiders should not be respected. Slaughter them as wounded wild animals, they are not deserve to live and see their families again.
archistBasis(tag=meme_SM_slaughtering) ->Archotechs are machine gods, we can only try to give them most precious thing that ever exist as a gift, and hope that is enough.
archistFact(tag=meme_SM_slaughtering) ->Archotechs are also known as Bloody Machine Gods. Who if not we gonna put blood at their table?
archistProphecy(tag=meme_SM_slaughtering) ->[inTheEnd], Archotechs must celebrate the spiritual feast. They are too advanced to eat the wiched flesh, so should do we.
animistFact(tag=meme_SM_slaughtering) ->Animals and Humans are equal not only in life, but in death too. We should sacrifice them equally, without preferences.
